preconditions.description: The number of game pieces n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= 10**9 for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each piece strength p_i is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(assignment) == n and all(c in {'A', 'B'} for c in assignment)
preconditions.description: The assignment string has length n and contains only 'A' or 'B'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max(sum(p[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i] == 'B'), sum(p[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i] == 'A') - sum(p[i] for i in range(k) if assignment[i] == 'A') + sum(p[i] for i in range(k) if assignment[i] == 'B'), sum(p[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i] == 'A') - sum(p[i] for i in range(n - k) if assignment[i] == 'A') + sum(p[i] for i in range(n - k) if assignment[i] == 'B') for k in range(1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum strength Bob can achieve by flipping any prefix or suffix of the assignment string (including doing nothing).
